phase_prompt.label: The Corrupted Runtime
phase_prompt.summary: The man stands as a solitary figure amidst the social collapse of the simulation, burdened by the guilt of a corrupted script. He transitions from a passive observer of the sky dome to the perpetrator of a familial deletion event.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic close-up of a man's face, etched with the tragedy of a fatal system error. The lighting is severe and dramatic, reminiscent of high-stakes cinema, isolating his expression of horror and resignation. His skin is illuminated by the faint, cold glow of a 'plasma' moon, while the surrounding darkness feels like a void in the data. Subtle 'vector_field' distortions ripple the air around him. He looks down, implied to be viewing the aftermath of his own violence, with the heavy, obsidian-like fabric of his garment weighing down his frame. The image quality is photorealistic, capturing the raw, unvarnished texture of a simulation running a tragedy protocol.
